verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a physical hardware authenticator that the user already owns and runs locally, so "self-hosting the core product" is a category error for this kind of product. The relying-party libraries (java-webauthn-server, python-fido2) let developers build their own servers, but that is integration tooling, not a self-hosted deployment of the YubiKey itself. The YubiEnterprise fleet API is a vendor service, not the core product.
